hero.title: Chandigarh University
hero.summary: Chandigarh University is a multidisciplinary private university in Punjab. ICAR’s verified agriculture decision concerns B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture specifically. Applicants should obtain direct confirmation of the current agriculture intake and teaching arrangements, as the admissions pages read did not establish an active degree-specific application route.

overview.heading: Agriculture enquiries at Chandigarh University
paragraphs: Chandigarh University’s Punjab campus forms part of a multidisciplinary university with institutes spanning engineering, business, sciences and related fields. The agriculture qualification relevant to this page is B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture, named in ICAR’s accreditation decision. It should be assessed through its own programme information rather than through the university’s broader marketing claims.

Applicants researching CU agriculture currently need a direct, programme-specific response from admissions. The official pages read include a current general admissions catalogue and an older international integrated agriculture–MBA page. Neither establishes the current domestic BSc agriculture intake, practical-learning schedule or payable charges. Obtain those details in writing before comparing CU with colleges whose current agriculture prospectus is available.

programmes.name: B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture
programmes.summary: B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture is the qualification named in ICAR’s 2022 decision. A current domestic programme page establishing duration, curriculum and entry conditions was not located; the legacy integrated BSc–MBA page concerns a different award.

fees.note: A dated official fee schedule with tuition, compulsory charges and residential costs was not verified.

programmes.icar_scope_note: Programme-only: ICAR’s 31st NAEAB proceedings approve B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture, 19 July 2022–18 July 2027; they explicitly do not approve the institute itself. No integrated BSc–MBA coverage is inferred.

admissions.heading: Planning an application to CU
admissions.intro: Chandigarh University’s general admissions page now refers to the 2027–28 intake and CUCET 2027. Its current general programme catalogue did not establish a domestic B.Sc.Agriculture offering in this research pass. Applicants must first obtain written confirmation of the programme, campus and intake before treating the historic accredited entry as an available seat.

steps.title: Confirm the current prospectus
steps.text: Ask the admissions office for the applicable intake, subject requirements and selection rules before submitting an application.

steps.title: Request a written cost statement
steps.text: Obtain tuition, compulsory charges, accommodation options and refund terms for the intended entry year.

campus.heading: Confirm the agriculture teaching arrangement
campus.intro: CU’s current institute list describes the wider academic campus. A programme-specific agriculture farm, laboratory inventory and field-training schedule were not verified. General university facilities are not substituted for evidence of agricultural teaching access.

scholarships.heading: Scholarships and financial support
scholarships.text: No current agriculture-specific scholarship terms were verified. The legacy international integrated-course page lists historical international concessions, which should not be applied to a domestic B.Sc. Agriculture enquiry.

placements.heading: Career support and outcomes
placements.text: CU pages display university-wide placement marketing, but the evidence read does not identify agriculture cohorts, recruiters or outcomes. Those wider figures are excluded from the agriculture profile.

recognition.heading: Recognition and programme accreditation
recognition.text: ICAR’s 31st NAEAB meeting proceedings approved B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture from 19 July 2022 to 18 July 2027 and explicitly did not approve University Institute of Agriculture Sciences itself. This is programme-specific accreditation. The locally audited workbook identity and printed labels are retained below without expanding the approved scope.

faculty.intro: A current named agriculture teaching roster was not verified in the pages read. Request the department-wise faculty list, qualifications and teaching responsibilities from the institution.

faqs.question: What agriculture qualification is confirmed by ICAR?
faqs.answer: The 31 st NAEAB proceedings approve B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture for 19 July 2022 to 18 July 2027.

faqs.question: Was the agriculture institute itself approved in that decision?
faqs.answer: No. The same proceedings explicitly say the University Institute of Agriculture Sciences was not approved for accreditation. The degree decision must not be expanded into blanket institute accreditation.

faqs.question: Is a current agriculture intake confirmed?
faqs.answer: No. The official admissions and institute pages read did not establish a current domestic agriculture application route. Ask CU admissions directly.

faqs.question: Can fees from the integrated international page be used?
faqs.answer: No. That page concerns an integrated agriculture–MBA award and retains Admissions 2016 navigation. It is not a current domestic agriculture fee schedule.

faqs.question: Are CU’s wider placement figures agriculture outcomes?
faqs.answer: The pages read do not provide an agriculture breakdown, so university-wide placement claims are not used as agriculture outcomes.

faqs.question: What establishment year is documented for CU?
faqs.answer: Chandigarh University is recorded as established in 2012.

faqs.question: Where is the official application information for CU?
faqs.answer: https://www.cuchd.in/admissions/ is a general admissions channel; the researched current catalogue does not confirm an available domestic agriculture intake.

faqs.question: How can applicants contact CU?
faqs.answer: Public telephone: 1800 1212 88800; Public email: admissions@cumail.in. These are institutional contact details, not an Agrico admissions guarantee.
